description: Sends a message from the Mac's Messages app: text, files, or both. to is a name from Contacts, a phone number, an email address, a group's name, or a conversation id from messages_find; for a person with several numbers and no conversation yet, the one Messages knows on iMessage, else a mobile number, is used and named in the answer. Attachments are paths of files on the Mac. If a name matches several people, nothing is sent and the choices are returned.

attachments.description: Paths of files on the Mac to send

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

to.description: Who or which conversation to send to

name: messages_send
title: Send a Message
